name: canvas-stub
description: Pure-JS stand-in for node-canvas, used only to satisfy mind-ar's own package.json listing canvas as a regular dependency. mind-ar's prebuilt browser dist (dist/mindar-image-three.prod.js — the only file this app imports) never actually calls into it; the real thing only has to exist for scripts/*.mjs, which resolve their own copy from scripts/node_modules (see scripts/package.json) and never touch this stub.
